```{js, making output folding possible, echo = F}
$(document).ready(function() {

  $chunks = $('.fold');

  $chunks.each(function () {

    // add button to source code chunks
    if ( $(this).hasClass('s') ) {
      $('pre.r', this).prepend("<div class=\"showopt\">Show Source</div><br style=\"line-height:22px;\"/>");
      $('pre.r', this).children('code').attr('class', 'folded');
    }

    // add button to output chunks
    if ( $(this).hasClass('o') ) {
      $('pre:not(.r)', this).has('code').prepend("<div class=\"showopt\">Output</div><br style=\"line-height:22px;\"/>");
      $('pre:not(.r)', this).children('code:not(r)').addClass('folded');

      // add button to plots
      $(this).find('img').wrap('<pre class=\"plot\"></pre>');
      $('pre.plot', this).prepend("<div class=\"showopt\">Show Plot</div><br style=\"line-height:22px;\"/>");
      $('pre.plot', this).children('img').addClass('folded');

    }
  });

  // hide all chunks when document is loaded
  $('.folded').css('display', 'none')

  // function to toggle the visibility
  $('.showopt').click(function() {
    var label = $(this).html();
    if (label.indexOf("Show") >= 0) {
      $(this).html(label.replace("Show", "Hide"));
    } else {
      $(this).html(label.replace("Hide", "Show"));
    }
    $(this).siblings('code, img').slideToggle('fast', 'swing');
  });
});
```

```{r, include = F}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)
library(rstatix)
library(bruceR)
library(lavaan)

d_white<-read.csv("~/Google Drive/ Graduate School/Projects/Longitudinal SES/Final Code & Data/For OSF - Will/Longitudinal Analyses/whiteCalcVar.csv")
d_black<-read.csv("~/Google Drive/ Graduate School/Projects/Longitudinal SES/Final Code & Data/For OSF - Will/Longitudinal Analyses/blackCalcVar.csv")

```


```{r, Longitudinal setup, include=FALSE}

d_white$GenderBinary<-ifelse(d_white$Gender_1 == 1, 0,
                           ifelse(d_white$Gender_1 == 2, 1, NA))

d_black$GenderBinary<-ifelse(d_black$Gender_1 == 1, 0,
                             ifelse(d_black$Gender_1 == 2, 1, NA))

#Standardizing separately for White and Black participants
scale1 <- function(x) scale(x)[,1]

d_white<-d_white %>% 
  mutate_at(vars(contains("LadderDif")), scale1)
d_white<-d_white %>% 
  mutate_at(vars(contains("negEmo")), scale1)
d_white<-d_white %>% 
  mutate_at(vars(contains("posEmo")), scale1)
d_white<-d_white %>% 
  mutate_at(vars(contains("dep")), scale1)
d_white<-d_white %>% 
  mutate_at(vars(contains("gSleep")), scale1) 
d_white<-d_white %>% 
  mutate_at(vars(contains("Age")), scale1)
d_white<-d_white %>% 
  mutate_at(vars(contains("Income")), scale1)
d_white<-d_white %>% 
  mutate_at(vars(contains("Edu")), scale1)
d_white<-d_white %>% 
  mutate_at(vars(contains("PolConserv")), scale1)

d_black<-d_black %>% 
  mutate_at(vars(contains("LadderDif")), scale1)
d_black<-d_black %>% 
  mutate_at(vars(contains("negEmo")), scale1)
d_black<-d_black %>% 
  mutate_at(vars(contains("posEmo")), scale1)
d_black<-d_black %>% 
  mutate_at(vars(contains("dep")), scale1)
d_black<-d_black %>% 
  mutate_at(vars(contains("gSleep")), scale1) 
d_black<-d_black %>% 
  mutate_at(vars(contains("Age")), scale1)
d_black<-d_black %>% 
  mutate_at(vars(contains("Income")), scale1)
d_black<-d_black %>% 
  mutate_at(vars(contains("Edu")), scale1)

d_all<-rbind(d_white, d_black)
```

# Model Comparisons

## No Constraints, second-order AR

```{r, warning = F, message = F, cache = T}
DepFree <- '

  # covariances
  
  LadderDif.1~~posEmo.1
  LadderDif.2~~posEmo.2
  LadderDif.3~~posEmo.3
  LadderDif.4~~posEmo.4
  LadderDif.5~~posEmo.5
  LadderDif.1~~dep.1
  LadderDif.2~~dep.2
  LadderDif.3~~dep.3
  LadderDif.4~~dep.4
  LadderDif.5~~dep.5
  dep.1~~posEmo.1
  dep.2~~posEmo.2
  dep.3~~posEmo.3
  dep.4~~posEmo.4
  dep.5~~posEmo.5
  
  # Regression of observed variables on controls
  
  LadderDif.1 + LadderDif.2 + LadderDif.3 + LadderDif.4 + LadderDif.5 ~ Gen1*GenderBinary
  posEmo.1 + posEmo.2 + posEmo.3 + posEmo.4 + posEmo.5 ~ Gen2*GenderBinary
  dep.1 + dep.2 + dep.3 + dep.4 + dep.5 ~ Gen3*GenderBinary
  LadderDif.1 + LadderDif.2 + LadderDif.3 + LadderDif.4 + LadderDif.5 ~ Edu1*Edu_1
  posEmo.1 + posEmo.2 + posEmo.3 + posEmo.4 + posEmo.5 ~ Edu2*Edu_1
  dep.1 + dep.2 + dep.3 + dep.4 + dep.5 ~ Edu3*Edu_1
  LadderDif.1 + LadderDif.2 + LadderDif.3 + LadderDif.4 + LadderDif.5 ~ Inc1*Income_1
  posEmo.1 + posEmo.2 + posEmo.3 + posEmo.4 + posEmo.5  ~ Inc2*Income_1
  dep.1 + dep.2 + dep.3 + dep.4 + dep.5  ~ Inc3*Income_1
  LadderDif.1 + LadderDif.2 + LadderDif.3 + LadderDif.4 + LadderDif.5 ~ Age1*Age_1
  posEmo.1 + posEmo.2 + posEmo.3 + posEmo.4 + posEmo.5  ~ Age2*Age_1
  dep.1 + dep.2 + dep.3 + dep.4 + dep.5  ~ Age3*Age_1
  
  # auto-regressive and cross-lagged paths
  
  dep.2 ~ dep.1 + posEmo.1
  dep.3 ~ dep.2 + posEmo.2 + dep.1
  dep.4 ~ dep.3 + posEmo.3 + dep.2
  dep.5 ~ dep.4 + posEmo.4 + dep.3
  LadderDif.2 ~ LadderDif.1 + posEmo.1 
  LadderDif.3 ~ LadderDif.2 + posEmo.2 + LadderDif.1 
  LadderDif.4 ~ LadderDif.3 + posEmo.3 + LadderDif.2 
  LadderDif.5 ~ LadderDif.4 + posEmo.4 + LadderDif.3 
  posEmo.2 ~ LadderDif.1 + dep.1 + posEmo.1
  posEmo.3 ~ LadderDif.2 + dep.2 + posEmo.2 + posEmo.1
  posEmo.4 ~ LadderDif.3 + dep.3 + posEmo.3 + posEmo.2
  posEmo.5 ~ LadderDif.4 + dep.4 + posEmo.4 + posEmo.3

'

set.seed(123)
DepFree.fit = sem(DepFree,data = d_all, meanstructure=T,missing="ML", int.ov.free = T,
                  se = "boot", bootstrap = 5000)

  posEmo.5 ~ LadderDif.4 + gSleep.4 + posEmo.4 + posEmo.3

'

set.seed(123)
```

## No constraints, first-order AR

```{r, warning = F, message = F, cache = T}
Dep1AR <- '

  # covariances
  
  LadderDif.1~~posEmo.1
  LadderDif.2~~posEmo.2
  LadderDif.3~~posEmo.3
  LadderDif.4~~posEmo.4
  LadderDif.5~~posEmo.5
  LadderDif.1~~dep.1
  LadderDif.2~~dep.2
  LadderDif.3~~dep.3
  LadderDif.4~~dep.4
  LadderDif.5~~dep.5
  dep.1~~posEmo.1
  dep.2~~posEmo.2
  dep.3~~posEmo.3
  dep.4~~posEmo.4
  dep.5~~posEmo.5
  
  # Regression of observed variables on controls
  
  LadderDif.1 + LadderDif.2 + LadderDif.3 + LadderDif.4 + LadderDif.5 ~ Gen1*GenderBinary
  posEmo.1 + posEmo.2 + posEmo.3 + posEmo.4 + posEmo.5 ~ Gen2*GenderBinary
  dep.1 + dep.2 + dep.3 + dep.4 + dep.5 ~ Gen3*GenderBinary
  LadderDif.1 + LadderDif.2 + LadderDif.3 + LadderDif.4 + LadderDif.5 ~ Edu1*Edu_1
  posEmo.1 + posEmo.2 + posEmo.3 + posEmo.4 + posEmo.5 ~ Edu2*Edu_1
  dep.1 + dep.2 + dep.3 + dep.4 + dep.5 ~ Edu3*Edu_1
  LadderDif.1 + LadderDif.2 + LadderDif.3 + LadderDif.4 + LadderDif.5 ~ Inc1*Income_1
  posEmo.1 + posEmo.2 + posEmo.3 + posEmo.4 + posEmo.5  ~ Inc2*Income_1
  dep.1 + dep.2 + dep.3 + dep.4 + dep.5  ~ Inc3*Income_1
  LadderDif.1 + LadderDif.2 + LadderDif.3 + LadderDif.4 + LadderDif.5 ~ Age1*Age_1
  posEmo.1 + posEmo.2 + posEmo.3 + posEmo.4 + posEmo.5  ~ Age2*Age_1
  dep.1 + dep.2 + dep.3 + dep.4 + dep.5  ~ Age3*Age_1
  
  # auto-regressive and cross-lagged paths
  
  dep.2 ~ dep.1 + posEmo.1
  dep.3 ~ dep.2 + posEmo.2 
  dep.4 ~ dep.3 + posEmo.3 
  dep.5 ~ dep.4 + posEmo.4 
  LadderDif.2 ~ LadderDif.1 + posEmo.1 
  LadderDif.3 ~ LadderDif.2 + posEmo.2 
  LadderDif.4 ~ LadderDif.3 + posEmo.3 
  LadderDif.5 ~ LadderDif.4 + posEmo.4 
  posEmo.2 ~ LadderDif.1 + dep.1 + posEmo.1
  posEmo.3 ~ LadderDif.2 + dep.2 + posEmo.2 
  posEmo.4 ~ LadderDif.3 + dep.3 + posEmo.3 
  posEmo.5 ~ LadderDif.4 + dep.4 + posEmo.4 

'

set.seed(123)
Dep1AR.fit = sem(Dep1AR,data = d_all, meanstructure=T,missing="ML", int.ov.free = T,
                    se = "boot", bootstrap = 5000)
```

### Compare 1st vs 2nd order AR 

```{r}
lavTestLRT(DepFree.fit, Dep1AR.fit)
lavTestLRT(SleepFree.fit, Sleep1AR.fit)
lavTestLRT(HealthFree.fit, Health1AR.fit)
```
Better fit with second-order AR specified

## Cross-Lagged Paths Constrained Over Time

```{r, warning = F, message = F, cache = T}
SleepTime <- '

  # covariances
  
  LadderDif.1~~posEmo.1
  LadderDif.2~~posEmo.2
  LadderDif.3~~posEmo.3
  LadderDif.4~~posEmo.4

  gSleep.1~~posEmo.1
  gSleep.2~~posEmo.2
  gSleep.3~~posEmo.3
  gSleep.4~~posEmo.4

  posEmo.1 + posEmo.2 + posEmo.3 + posEmo.4 + posEmo.5 ~ Gen2*GenderBinary
  gSleep.1 + gSleep.2 + gSleep.3 + gSleep.4 + gSleep.5 ~ Gen3*GenderBinary

  gSleep.1 + gSleep.2 + gSleep.3 + gSleep.4 + gSleep.5  ~ Inc3*Income_1
  LadderDif.1 + LadderDif.2 + LadderDif.3 + LadderDif.4 + LadderDif.5 ~ Age1*Age_1

  gSleep.1 + gSleep.2 + gSleep.3 + gSleep.4 + gSleep.5  ~ Age3*Age_1
  
  # auto-regressive and cross-lagged paths
  
  gSleep.2 ~ gSleep.1 + b1*posEmo.1
  gSleep.3 ~ gSleep.2 + b1*posEmo.2 + gSleep.1
  gSleep.4 ~ gSleep.3 + b1*posEmo.3 + gSleep.2
  gSleep.5 ~ gSleep.4 + b1*posEmo.4 + gSleep.3
  LadderDif.2 ~ LadderDif.1 + b2*posEmo.1

  posEmo.4 ~ a1*LadderDif.3 + a2*gSleep.3 + posEmo.3 + posEmo.2
  posEmo.5 ~ a1*LadderDif.4 + a2*gSleep.4 + posEmo.4 + posEmo.3

'
```

### Compare time constrained vs free
```{r}
lavTestLRT(DepFree.fit, DepTime.fit)
lavTestLRT(SleepFree.fit, SleepTime.fit)
lavTestLRT(HealthFree.fit, HealthTime.fit)
```
Adding cross-lagged constraints doesn't significantly affect model fit -- using constraints going forward

```{r, warning = F, message = F, cache = T}
  gSleep.1 + gSleep.2 + gSleep.3 + gSleep.4 + gSleep.5  ~ Inc3*Income_1
  LadderDif.1 + LadderDif.2 + LadderDif.3 + LadderDif.4 + LadderDif.5 ~ Age1*Age_1
  posEmo.1 + posEmo.2 + posEmo.3 + posEmo.4 + posEmo.5  ~ Age2*Age_1
  gSleep.1 + gSleep.2 + gSleep.3 + gSleep.4 + gSleep.5  ~ Age3*Age_1
  
  # auto-regressive and cross-lagged paths
  
  gSleep.2 ~ gSleep.1 + b1*posEmo.1
  gSleep.3 ~ gSleep.2 + b1*posEmo.2 + gSleep.1
  gSleep.4 ~ gSleep.3 + b1*posEmo.3 + gSleep.2
  gSleep.5 ~ gSleep.4 + b1*posEmo.4 + gSleep.3
  LadderDif.2 ~ LadderDif.1 + b2*posEmo.1 
  LadderDif.3 ~ LadderDif.2 + b2*posEmo.2 + LadderDif.1 
  LadderDif.4 ~ LadderDif.3 + b2*posEmo.3 + LadderDif.2 
  LadderDif.5 ~ LadderDif.4 + b2*posEmo.4 + LadderDif.3 
  posEmo.2 ~ a1*LadderDif.1 + a2*gSleep.1 + posEmo.1
  posEmo.3 ~ a1*LadderDif.2 + a2*gSleep.2 + posEmo.2 + posEmo.1
  posEmo.4 ~ a1*LadderDif.3 + a2*gSleep.3 + posEmo.3 + posEmo.2
  posEmo.5 ~ a1*LadderDif.4 + a2*gSleep.4 + posEmo.4 + posEmo.3

'
set.seed(123)
SleepGroupC.fit = sem(SleepGroupC, data = d_all, meanstructure=T,missing="ML", int.ov.free = T, group = "PSBlack",
                      se = "boot", bootstrap = 5000)
```

### Compare group free vs. group constrained
```{r}
lavTestLRT(DepGroupF.fit, DepGroupC.fit)
lavTestLRT(SleepGroupF.fit, SleepGroupC.fit)
lavTestLRT(HealthGroupF.fit, HealthGroupC.fit)
```

The models with effects free to vary across race fits better than the models with effects constrained across race. Running separate models for racial groups going forward

```{r, cache = T}
DepressNeg <- '

  # covariances
  
  LadderDif.1~~negEmo.1
  LadderDif.2~~negEmo.2
  LadderDif.3~~negEmo.3
  LadderDif.4~~negEmo.4
  LadderDif.5~~negEmo.5
  LadderDif.1~~dep.1
  LadderDif.2~~dep.2
  LadderDif.3~~dep.3
  LadderDif.4~~dep.4

  dep.2~~negEmo.2
  dep.3~~negEmo.3
  dep.4~~negEmo.4
  dep.5~~negEmo.5

  negEmo.1 + negEmo.2 + negEmo.3 + negEmo.4 + negEmo.5 ~ Gen2*GenderBinary
  dep.1 + dep.2 + dep.3 + dep.4 + dep.5 ~ Gen3*GenderBinary
  LadderDif.1 + LadderDif.2 + LadderDif.3 + LadderDif.4 + LadderDif.5 ~ Edu1*Edu_1
  negEmo.1 + negEmo.2 + negEmo.3 + negEmo.4 + negEmo.5 ~ Edu2*Edu_1
  dep.1 + dep.2 + dep.3 + dep.4 + dep.5 ~ Edu3*Edu_1
  LadderDif.1 + LadderDif.2 + LadderDif.3 + LadderDif.4 + LadderDif.5 ~ Inc1*Income_1
  negEmo.1 + negEmo.2 + negEmo.3 + negEmo.4 + negEmo.5  ~ Inc2*Income_1
  dep.1 + dep.2 + dep.3 + dep.4 + dep.5  ~ Inc3*Income_1
  LadderDif.1 + LadderDif.2 + LadderDif.3 + LadderDif.4 + LadderDif.5 ~ Age1*Age_1

  negEmo.5 ~ a1*LadderDif.4 + a2*dep.4 + negEmo.4 + negEmo.3

'

  LadderDif.1 + LadderDif.2 + LadderDif.3 + LadderDif.4 + LadderDif.5 ~ Edu1*Edu_1
  negEmo.1 + negEmo.2 + negEmo.3 + negEmo.4 + negEmo.5 ~ Edu2*Edu_1
  gHealth.1 + gHealth.2 + gHealth.3 + gHealth.4 + gHealth.5 ~ Edu3*Edu_1
  LadderDif.1 + LadderDif.2 + LadderDif.3 + LadderDif.4 + LadderDif.5 ~ Inc1*Income_1
  negEmo.1 + negEmo.2 + negEmo.3 + negEmo.4 + negEmo.5  ~ Inc2*Income_1
  gHealth.1 + gHealth.2 + gHealth.3 + gHealth.4 + gHealth.5  ~ Inc3*Income_1
  LadderDif.1 + LadderDif.2 + LadderDif.3 + LadderDif.4 + LadderDif.5 ~ Age1*Age_1
  negEmo.1 + negEmo.2 + negEmo.3 + negEmo.4 + negEmo.5  ~ Age2*Age_1
  gHealth.1 + gHealth.2 + gHealth.3 + gHealth.4 + gHealth.5  ~ Age3*Age_1
  
  # auto-regressive and cross-lagged paths
  
  gHealth.2 ~ gHealth.1 + b1*negEmo.1
  gHealth.3 ~ gHealth.2 + b1*negEmo.2 + gHealth.1
  gHealth.4 ~ gHealth.3 + b1*negEmo.3 + gHealth.2
  gHealth.5 ~ gHealth.4 + b1*negEmo.4 + gHealth.3
  LadderDif.2 ~ LadderDif.1 + b2*negEmo.1 
  LadderDif.3 ~ LadderDif.2 + b2*negEmo.2 + LadderDif.1 
  LadderDif.4 ~ LadderDif.3 + b2*negEmo.3 + LadderDif.2 
  LadderDif.5 ~ LadderDif.4 + b2*negEmo.4 + LadderDif.3 
  negEmo.2 ~ a1*LadderDif.1 + a2*gHealth.1 + negEmo.1
  negEmo.3 ~ a1*LadderDif.2 + a2*gHealth.2 + negEmo.2 + negEmo.1
  negEmo.4 ~ a1*LadderDif.3 + a2*gHealth.3 + negEmo.3 + negEmo.2
  negEmo.5 ~ a1*LadderDif.4 + a2*gHealth.4 + negEmo.4 + negEmo.3

'
set.seed(123)
HealthNegW.fit = sem(HealthNeg, data = d_white, meanstructure=T,missing="ML", int.ov.free = T,
                       se = "boot", bootstrap = 5000)
set.seed(123)
HealthNegB.fit = sem(HealthNeg, data = d_black, meanstructure=T,missing="ML", int.ov.free = T,
                       se = "boot", bootstrap = 5000)
```
